tagline: मंडी खोजें। भाव समझें। सही निर्णय लें।
hero_desc: मंडीक्लस्टर (MandiCluster) कृषि उपज मंडियों के ऐतिहासिक भावों का मशीन लर्निंग द्वारा विश्लेषण करता है, समान मूल्य पैटर्न वाले बाजारों को खोजता है, असामान्य उतार-चढ़ाव की पहचान करता है और किसानों को परिवहन लागत घटाकर शुद्ध लाभ की तुलना प्रदान करता है।

market_analysis.title: कृषि मंडी मूल्य व आवक विश्लेषण
market_analysis.subtitle: विभिन्न मंडियों के ऐतिहासिक मॉडल भाव, मूल्य विचलन और मौसमी आवक की सटीक तुलना करें।
market_analysis.empty_state: चुने गए विकल्पों हेतु कोई डेटा उपलब्ध नहीं है। कृपया फसल अथवा दिनांक बदलें।

clustering.title: मंडी क्लस्टरिंग विश्लेषण
clustering.subtitle: समान मूल्य स्तर एवं अस्थिरता व्यवहार वाली कृषि मंडियों का अनसुपरवाइज्ड मशीन लर्निंग वर्गीकरण।
clustering.disclaimer_note: ध्यान दें: क्लस्टर संख्या केवल एक सांकेतिक पहचान है, यह मंडियों की गुणवत्ता या श्रेणी का निर्धारण नहीं करती।

evaluation.title: Cluster Evaluation Dashboard
evaluation.subtitle: Quantitative validation of clustering quality, separation, compactness, and stability across parameter choices.
evaluation.inertia_title: Elbow Curve: Inertia vs. Number of Clusters (K)
evaluation.silhouette_desc: Silhouette Score measures how closely each market aligns with its own cluster versus neighboring clusters (-1 to +1). Values closer to +1 represent superior separation.
evaluation.db_desc: Davies–Bouldin Index evaluates the ratio of within-cluster scatter to between-cluster separation. Lower scores indicate tighter, better-separated clusters.
evaluation.elbow_desc: Inertia (Within-Cluster Sum of Squares) naturally decreases as K increases. The 'elbow point' marks where adding another cluster yields diminishing returns in variance reduction.
evaluation.stability_desc: Cluster Stability evaluates whether cluster assignments remain consistent when subsampling 85% of markets over repeated bootstrap iterations.

pca_tsne.title: Dimensionality Reduction: PCA vs. t-SNE
pca_tsne.subtitle: Comparing linear global-variance preservation against non-linear local-neighborhood manifold embedding.
pca_tsne.linear_vs_nonlinear: PCA is a linear orthogonal projection that maximizes total variance captured. t-SNE is a non-linear probabilistic technique tailored for preserving local pairwise affinities.
pca_tsne.global_vs_local: PCA preserves global Euclidean geometry, making distant points genuinely far apart in feature space. t-SNE focuses on local neighbors; inter-cluster visual distances should not be interpreted as metric distances.
pca_tsne.interpretability: PCA axes correspond directly to linear combinations of agricultural features (e.g., mean price, CV). t-SNE embedding axes possess no direct physical or economic interpretation.

anomaly.title: Statistical Anomaly & Outlier Detection
anomaly.subtitle: Identify atypical market observations in historical price trajectories using unsupervised anomaly algorithms.
anomaly.chart_title: Historical Modal Price with Flagged Observations
anomaly.neutral_notice: Interpretation Notice: A flagged observation is a statistical deviation from the model baseline. It is not evidence of fraud, incorrect data, or manipulation. Common causes include unseasonal rains, harvest arrival spikes, transport disruptions, or local festival demand surges.

recommendations.title: मंडी तुलना एवं शुद्ध लाभ कैलकुलेटर
recommendations.subtitle: परिवहन व ढुलाई लागत घटाकर वास्तविक शुद्ध भाव की तुलना करें और अपनी उपज के लिए सर्वोत्तम मंडी चुनें।
recommendations.disclaimer_text: यह कैलकुलेटर एगमार्कनेट के प्रकाशित भावों और अनुमानित सड़क भाड़े पर आधारित निर्णय-सहायता उपकरण है। यह किसी निश्चित मूल्य या लाभ की गारंटी नहीं देता।

about.title: About MandiCluster
about.subtitle: Discover Markets. Understand Prices. Make Informed Decisions.
about.problem_desc: Agricultural producers in India frequently sell crops in immediate local mandis without transparent insight into price behavior at alternative regional markets. Price dispersion across neighboring districts often exceeds transport costs, yet smallholders lack intuitive analytical tools to evaluate where and when to sell.
about.objectives_desc: MandiCluster bridges this gap by applying unsupervised machine learning: clustering mandis with similar price patterns, providing quantitative cluster evaluations, visualizing price embeddings with PCA and t-SNE, flagging statistical outliers, and calculating net proceeds adjusted for freight costs.
about.methodology_desc: Observations are aggregated per market over consistent commodity windows to avoid multi-scale distortions. Statistical features include mean and median modal prices, coefficient of variation, normalized price range, linear trend slope, and arrival volumes. Preprocessing applies StandardScaler before model fitting.
about.limitations_desc: Insights depend upon AGMARKNET reporting regularity and accuracy. Auction quality premiums (variety, moisture content) are not captured in aggregate modal prices. Calculations represent decision support, not financial guarantees.
